act_title: The Union Territories (Separation of Judicial and Executive Functions) Act, 1969
title: In sub-section (3) of section 439, for the words “a Magistrate of the first class”, the
text:
77. In sub-section (3) of section 439, for the words “a Magistrate of the first class”, the

words “a judicial Magistrate of the first class” shall be substituted.
